{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse the revenue column
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the fraction of loyal customers who converted
fraction_converted = loyal_customers['converted'].mean()

# Confirm the number of loyal customers
num_loyal = len(loyal_customers)

# Output the fraction and supporting numbers
print(f'Number of loyal customers: {num_loyal}')
print(f'Number of converted loyal customers: {loyal_customers[loyal_customers["converted"] == 1].shape[0]}')
print(f'Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}')"}
